description: Exempt a company record's orders from VAT, or clear the exemption with null. An exempt company's carts and orders carry 0% and 0 tax with reason as the legal note, whatever its VAT id; in a workspace that stores gross prices the VAT inside them is removed, not charged. Carts already holding the old status are refused at checkout (BUYER_CHANGED) and orders keep the treatment they were placed with. Needs customers:manage and site:config:edit, the same pair as set_company_vat_verified and as linking a customer to a company whose VAT id is verified or that is tax exempt. Refused for a record that is not a company (a model with the Company capability). Returns the record id with vatId, vatCountry, vatVerifiedAt, vatVerifiedBy and taxExemptReason.

reason.description: The legal basis of the exemption, printed on each of the company's orders (3-300 characters); null clears the exemption

recordId.description: The company record's id (a record of a model with the Company capability; a customer's company.id)

name: set_company_tax_exemption
title: Set company tax exemption
